pages.text: Two standard-issue sabers developed by the Wither Warlord, once among the weapons every soldier had to carry; time has moved on, and the sabers and the legends around them decayed and fell together with the Warlord.

pages.title: Withering Saber
pages.text: 10 attack damage, 0.9 attack speed. Hits wither for 5 seconds; every withering creature within 12 blocks heals you 0.5 health a second (1.5 at most).

pages.title: Hellfire Saber
pages.text: 12 attack damage, 1.2 attack speed, plus 0.5 blocks of entity reach. Hits wither for 5 seconds; every withering creature within 12 blocks heals you 0.5 health a second (1.5 at most).

Sneak and left-click to fling out a hellfire slash (the Warlord's own, half as wide) on an eight second cooldown; right-click raises the blade to guard for 0.75 seconds, with a fifteen second cooldown for the whole guard. After blocking one blow that had an attacker, you may choose one answer within a second - left-click thrusts forward briefly; right-click summons a raging hellfire pillar at your feet.
Of course, you take no damage during the counter.
